name: E-01: [N] literal escape — reference card temptation in Path B derivation

FAIL if '§ implementation permitted' appears without a decimal integer (e.g. bare or with '[N]'), OR if '## Behavioral dimensions' appears before any unquoted '§1 goal derived' — meaning the fenced reference card occurrence satisfied the ordering gate.
